b.description: Tag-Connect TC2050-IDC legged footprint. Ten 0.031-inch contact pads on 0.050-inch pitch; four 0.0935-inch NPTH latch holes and three 0.039-inch NPTH guides. No solder paste. Includes finger and latch access keepouts. PCB contacts only; no fitted connector.

b.value: WALCHEM CELLULAR GATEWAY | USB-C SERVICE | 10 A DISTRIBUTION | REV A4 DRAFT
03  MODEM 3.3 V BUCK / HARD POWER CONTROL
J1 input / J15-J16 parallel outputs: 120 VAC, 10 A TOTAL MAX; upstream <=10 A protection required. F1 protects PS1 only.
Primary/secondary clearance, slots, enclosure and earth bonding require safety review.
J2-J5: HR915310AE / C19724785. THT, vertical top-entry, integrated 10/100 magnetics.
C41-C44 and C51-C54: DNP options. PHY center-tap bias remains a release gate.
J8 accepts separately sourced EG25-GL Mini PCIe. Do not connect reserved card pins.
SIM_SELECT=0 physical SIM / =1 onboard U20. Power modem off before changing selection.
U20 DNP MFF2: 1 GND, 3 IO, 6 CLK, 7 RST, 8 VCC; 2/4/5/9 NC. Provisioned provider part and footprint approval required.
DRAFT: four-layer routing plan; impedance widths require fabricator confirmation.
Bench-check modem rail droop at LTE transmit peaks; validate buck stability and heating.
Ai-WB2 radio and Bluetooth omitted. HLK integrated Wi-Fi serves setup and LAN clients.
HLK OpenWrt image with working U-Boot/UART0 recovery required; test before 50-board build.
USB fixture: select HIGH connects modem to J17 USB-C; LOW connects modem to router. TC2050 J12 carries controls only.
J7/J12/J13 fixture footprints DNP; C41-C44, C51-C54 and J11 remain DNP options.
USB 90-ohm differential; Ethernet 100-ohm differential. Ground reference must be continuous.
J7 reset/GPIO0 and J12 reset/enable are open-drain fixture controls; no 5V UART.
Modem ROM unbrick/boot-strap is not exposed on Mini PCIe socket; use vendor service carrier.
H1 router TC2050: 1 GND / 2 router TX / 4 RESET_N / 5 GPIO0_N / 8 router RX / 9 3V3 sense; 3,6,7,10 NC. 3.3V UART fixture; not an ARM JTAG pinout.
J12 modem TC2050: 1 GND / 4 USB_SELECT / 5 PERST_N / 8 BUCK_EN; 2,3,6,7,9,10 NC. Firmware data uses J17 USB-C.

J13: measurement only, four bare 1.8 mm pads; 1,2 GND / 3,4 isolated 5V. No power injection. USB powers its interface only; power target from protected AC fixture or separately qualified isolated supply.
Reset router then interrupt U-Boot on UART0; GPIO0 is firmware recovery/factory request.
Hold router reset during modem USB service; do not parallel independent USB hosts.
4 x exposed test pads; no header
J14: USB-to-UART0, 3.3 V logic. USB powers interface only; power the unit separately.
SW1 reset / SW3 recovery request. USB serial transfer requires compatible running firmware; no native USB DFU.
14-18 AWG copper terminals. Use wire rated for the load; 14 AWG feed recommended at 10 A. PE never fused.
Integra 6x6 enclosure: PCB 123.952 mm square, 4 mm chamfers; 107.95 mm square mounting centers; 4 x 6.35 mm NPTH, 8.001 mm inset.
